title: PairAlign: A Framework for Autoregressive Tokenization via Self-Alignment with Applications to Audio Tokenization
abstract: arXiv:2605.06582v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern learning systems represent perceptual signals with continuous vectors, but comparison, retrieval, memory, alignment, and reasoning are often symbolic. In language, tokens provide this interface; for speech and audio, it must be learned. Existing audio tokenizers rely on local quantization, clustering, or reconstruction, leaving sequence consistency, compactness, length, termination, and edit geometry only indirectly controlled. We introduce PairAlign, a framework for compact audio tokenization through autoregressive self-alignment. An encoder maps speech to a continuous condition, and an autoregressive decoder emits tokens from BOS to EOS. Given two content-preserving views, PairAlign derives a canonical anchor target and trains both views to predict it, with unrelated in-batch targets as competing sequences. translated_title: PairAlign：一种基于自对齐的自回归词元化框架及其在音频词元化中的应用
translated_abstract: 现代学习系统使用连续向量来表示感知信号，但比较、检索、记忆、对齐和推理往往是符号化的。在语言中，词元提供了这种接口；而对于语音和音频，这种接口必须通过学习获得。现有的音频词元化器依赖于局部量化、聚类或重建，使得序列一致性、紧凑性、长度、终止和编辑几何特性只能被间接控制。我们提出了PairAlign，一个通过自回归自对齐实现紧凑音频词元化的框架。编码器将语音映射为连续条件，自回归解码器从BOS到EOS生成词元。给定两个保持内容的视图，PairAlign推导出一个规范的锚点目标，并训练两个视图来预测它，同时以批内无关目标作为竞争序列。该框架首先从VQ目标学习自回归桥梁，然后过渡到EMA教师自对齐（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: PairAlign提出了一种通过自回归自对齐实现紧凑音频词元化的框架，通过让两个内容保持视图预测统一的规范锚点目标，实现了序列一致性、紧凑性和长度等特性的可控音频离散表示。
en_tdlr: PairAlign introduces a framework for compact audio tokenization via autoregressive self-alignment, training content-preserving views to predict a canonical anchor target for controllable sequence consistency, compactness, and length in discrete audio representations.
